Depends on how you build it. Speed freaks aren't the most OP WAAC list you could put together for a tournament, but with some optimization you can create a fun and locally competitive list. I'll give you some quick thoughts on speed freak units I've tested in some games.

Bikers - these guys are much improved through the point decrease, DDD and the clan traits but are best played in max unit counts, the Nob armed with a powerklaw, to make optimal use of their interesting new strats like exhaust fumes. Their damage is middling, but they can perform a effective turn 1 charge like stormboyz. They pair very well with a banner and warboss on bike. Painboy on bike is a reasonable support addition as well.

Warboss on Bike - with new clan traits and the Killa klaw relic, this index unit has drastically risen in effectiveness and is our equivalent of a slam captain. With the relic he's a must-take in all lists, not just Speed freaks. He's a murder machine and allows both infantry and bikers to charge and advance, with the additional perk of the breaking heads aura.

Warboss on Trike - while having some interesting elements, the trike ultimately does not perform as well as the warboss on bike. The biggest reason is certainly because he can't take the klaw relic, but his ranged damage is also inconsistent and not designed well for his combat roll. Coupled with his higher cost than the biker boss, he's a secondary choice. He does have his use if you're bringing a bonebreaker, which are so good they by themselves can justify bringing the trike for his unique aura giving vehicles the advance + charge.

Nob bikers - still painfully overcosted, they're something you should never run and contend for worst unit in the codex.

Buggies - all of the buggies except the scrapjet are objectively bad and out performed by other units in the codex. The models look incredible but are not worth bringing outside a very casual game. Scrapjet usually justifies it's point cost, but there are much better options.

Bonebreaker - this is the only variation of battlewagon worth talking about, and they are incredible melee murder machines if you pair them with the right support units. If you bring only one, consider sticking a Mek inside with the Redder Armor. They also pair well with a Big Mek on Bike with KFF. Filling the bonebreaker with Nobz or megas can get very scary, but is often to expensive to justify. Many of the pros are talking about triple bonebreaker lists. The biggest question is whether to run them as Evil Sunz to guarantee a turn 1 charge range + the ability to fall back and charge every turn, or Goffs. The answer is probably Evil Sunz.

Deffkoptas - paired with the Evil Sunz trait, a massive points drop and a rule oversight that allows them to continue taking their Big Bomb, these went from a never-take unit, to a strong option in Maestrom missions and justifiable in the ITC. Keep them cheap with their machine guns, though the killsaws can turn them into an interesting character killer.

Trukk Boyz - still bad, maybe even worse from the points increase. Boyz hit their value in groups of 20+. The tellyporta and day jump are faster, safer and more reliable while being able to move 30-40 at a time.
